description: Ministry of Ports and Shipping - Regulations of the Merchant Shipping (Small Commercial Vessels), 2017 under the Merchant Shipping Act
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Ports and Shipping under the Merchant Shipping Act, No. 52 of 1971. It establishes new regulatory requirements for small commercial vessels, including registration procedures, safety standards, inspection requirements, and penalties for non-compliance. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it creates new subsidiary legislation and regulatory frameworks.
